description: The Queue's build requests, held in the playlist store and written only here. Answered only to main KSAserver's own key: the requests hold the emails of learners who asked for their result by email; any other caller is refused. action list (the default) answers the requests, the newest first, with an optional limit. action get, with request_id, answers one. action open, with request (the request to write) and open_statuses, writes it unless a request for the same key (a policy rebuild: its school; a checklist build: its checklist) has one of those statuses, in which case the optional learner joins that request; started says which. action requeue, with request_id, open_statuses and set, sets those fields on the request unless another request for the same key has one of those statuses; queued says which, with the reason. action set, with request_id and set, sets those fields. action carry_over, with source and requests, carries main's old request file over once; without requests it answers whether the carry-over was made.

action.description: list (the default), get, open, requeue, set or carry_over

learner.description: Optional, with open: the learner who joins an open request

limit.description: Optional, with list: how many requests to answer; absent, all

open_statuses.description: With open or requeue: the statuses of a request still building

request.description: With open: the request to write

request_id.description: With get, requeue or set: the request

requests.description: Optional, with carry_over: the requests to carry over

set.description: With requeue or set: the fields to set

source.description: With carry_over and requests: where the requests were held

name: playlist_build_requests
title: Playlist Build Requests
